description: OpenSim Moco inverse solve through the persistent Python session. Run with: python scripts/run_spec.py template/moco-inverse.json
note: Moco goes through run_python (op: run_python) because a study object has to persist across calls. Requires an IK motion in radians and a ground-reaction file. The state carries over between successive run_python ops, so study/problem/solution stay live for inspection.

args.source:
import opensim as osim
osim.Logger.setLevelString('Error')
model = osim.Model(str(resolve_model('rajagopal2016')))
model.initSystem()
print('model ok:', model.getName(), model.getNumCoordinates(), 'coordinates')

# Build the MocoInverse problem. Adjust the two paths below.
ik_path = 'ik.mot'
grf_path = 'grf.xml'

kinematics = osim.TableProcessor(ik_path)
kinematics.append(osim.TabOpConvertDegreesToRadians())

inverse = osim.MocoInverse()
inverse.setModel(model)
inverse.setKinematics(kinematics)
inverse.set_initial_time(0.0)
inverse.set_final_time(1.0)
inverse.set_mesh_interval(0.02)
inverse.set_convergence_tolerance(1e-2)
inverse.set_external_loads(osim.ExternalLoads(grf_path, True))
print('study configured')

solution = inverse.solve()
sol = solution.getMocoSolution()
sol.write('moco_inverse_solution.sto')
print('success:', sol.success())
print('objective:', sol.getObjective())
